tips.title: Define CAM-Part name and location
tips.body: InventorCAM creates necessary system files and a folder for storing data.

tips.title: Select CNC-controller for CAM-Part definition
tips.body: Choose the controller type which influences Coordinate System and Geometry definitions.

tips.title: Define Coordinate System for CAM-Part
tips.body: Set the origin for all machining operations and create multiple CoordSys positions.

tips.title: Define CAM-Part in Milling Part Data dialog box
tips.body: Select the CNC-Machine and define the coordinate system for this part.

tips.title: Set Facet tolerance value for target definition
tips.body: Ensure the Facet tolerance value is set as 0.01.

tips.title: Select solid for target definition
tips.body: Click the Target button and select the solid as shown in the image.

tips.title: Add Milling Operation > Geodesic Machining > Multiaxis
tips.body: Right-click Setup and add a new Geodesic Machining operation.

tips.title: Select Surfaces for Geodesic Machining
tips.body: In the Geometry selection section, click Surfaces and select all faces of the model.

tips.title: Select LOLLIPOP MILL tool for Geodesic Machining
tips.body: On the TOOLKIT page, select the LOLLIPOP MILL tool.

tips.title: Set tool holder and adaptor
tips.body: HSK A 63 SRKIN 16x95 as the Holder and BT40 as the Adaptor.

tips.title: Select tool center mode
tips.body: Click to confirm the tool and select Tool center mode in Calculation mode list.

tips.title: Create a sketch for constraint boundary
tips.body: Click Sketch > Start 2D Sketch and select the highlighted plane to create a circle.

tips.title: Set constraint boundary parameters
tips.body: Select the mid point, create a circle, and set Boundary type to Created manually with Same as guide curve.

tips.title: Set tool path parameters
tips.body: Set Cut tolerance to 0.05 and select Constant Step Over in the Step over list.

tips.title: Configure tool axis control
tips.body: Select Tilted to axis by fixed angle in the Tool axis direction list.

tips.title: Set lead-in and lead-out parameters
tips.body: Select Use Lead-In and Use Lead-Out in the First entry and Last exit lists, respectively.

tips.title: Configure default lead-in/lead-out
tips.body: Select T angential arc in the Type list for Default Lead-In/Out.

tips.title: Set machine limits
tips.body: Select No limits in the Machine limits list.
